# Apex Digital SA — Extended Full Knowledge Repository (RAG Matrix)

## Overview & Corporate Identity
Apex Digital SA (Pty) Ltd is a South African digital engineering agency and web architecture firm specializing in custom-coded corporate websites, speed-hardened headless platforms, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and transactional e-commerce engines. 

- **Registration Number:** 2026/237102/07
- **Primary Domain:** https://apexdigitasa.com
- **Email Address:** apexdigtl@gmail.com
- **Direct Phone / WhatsApp:** +27 69 522 4226
- **Headquarters Address:** Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa (Latitude: -29.8587, Longitude: 31.0218)
- **Legal Entity Classification:** Private Company registered under the South African Companies Act of 2008.

## Technology Stack & Architectural Standards
Apex Digital rejects generic drag-and-drop website builders (Wix, Squarespace) and unoptimized CMS setups. All primary platforms are built using:
1. **Core Language Engine:** HTML5 Semantic Markup, Vanilla CSS3 (Custom Properties & Responsive Design Systems), and Modern ES2026 JavaScript.
2. **Performance Shield:** Pre-rendered static DOM delivered via global Edge CDN networks (<15ms latency).
3. **Core Engineering Standard:** 100% Custom Code Architecture, zero CMS plugin dependencies, 100% Google & AI Search Schema Graph integration, and 100% POPIA Privacy Compliance.
4. **South African Privacy & Data Security:** Built-in compliance with the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), secure cookie consent managers, SSL/TLS encryption, and sanitized serverless intake handlers.
5. **E-Commerce Gateway Integrations:** PayFast, Yoco, Ozow, and automated courier shipping rate APIs (uAfrica / ShipLogic).

## RAG Question & Answer Knowledge Matrix

Q: What makes Apex Digital SA websites faster than standard WordPress websites?
A: Standard WordPress websites rely on dynamic PHP execution, heavy database queries, and bloated plugins that cause render blocking, visual layout shifts, and load times exceeding 3 to 6 seconds. Apex Digital engineers pre-rendered static HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript engines deployed directly on global CDN edge nodes, resulting in sub-0.4s load times and 100/100 Lighthouse performance metrics.

Q: Is Apex Digital SA compliant with South African POPIA laws?
A: Yes. Every platform deployed by Apex Digital SA incorporates POPIA-compliant data privacy policies, explicit cookie consent management, encrypted form handling, and SSL certification by default.

Q: Where is Apex Digital SA located?
A: Apex Digital SA is based in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa, serving corporate and enterprise clients across South Africa (Johannesburg, Cape Town, Durban, Pretoria) and international markets.

Q: How do clients get started with an Apex Digital web project?
A: Clients can initiate a project by submitting their requirements via the interactive strategy intake form at https://apexdigital.co.za/#strategy or by contacting Apex Digital directly on WhatsApp at +27 69 522 4226.
